depends_on.description: Ids of the layers this layer may import from.

path.description: Directory relative to the project root; a module belongs to the layer with the longest matching path.

slices.description: Each direct child of `path`, folder or source file, is a slice: a container isolated from its siblings.

files.description: Globs matched against forward-slash paths relative to the project root.

OverrideRule.description: Severity only: options and scripts come from the base `rules` entry.

entry_points.description: Globs relative to the project root of the files the program starts from: the roots of reachability for `stratum/unused-exports` and `stratum/unreachable-modules`. Required when either rule is on; each glob must match a module. A child list replaces the `extends` parent's list.

extends.description: A config file path relative to this file, or a built-in preset: `stratum:recommended`, `stratum:fsd`.

ignore.description: Globs relative to the project root, on top of the built-in defaults (`node_modules`, `dist`, `out`, `build`, `coverage`, `.git`, `*.d.ts`). Matching files and directories are never walked or parsed; imports of them make no edge. `!glob` un-ignores; the last matching glob wins. Appended after the `extends` parent's list.

options.description: Rule-specific, validated against the rule when the config loads: unknown keys are errors.

script.description: A `.rhai` script relative to the project root that implements this slug as a plugin rule.

Structure.description: Names that shape containers. Each list matches whole path components, never substrings.

entries.description: Exact file names. A folder holding one is a container, and that file is its only import target from outside.

private.description: Private-zone folder names: visible only inside their parent folder's subtree.

segments.description: Folder names that group a container's files by purpose. A segment folder is never a container.

layers.description: Merged with the `extends` parent by `id`: a child entry overrides the parent entry field by field.

overrides.description: Appended after the `extends` parent's overrides; the last matching block wins per rule.

rules.description: Keyed by rule slug. Merged with the `extends` parent by slug, field by field.

structure.description: Merged with the `extends` parent field by field; a child list replaces the parent's list.
